steps.speaker: Yagyu Executive
steps.content: Humph... Liar, fool, you mere Sinners... Who exactly are you?! Are you a lackey of the Legion's after all?

options: Say whatever you want. It's time for your punishment.

steps.speaker: Yagyu Executive
steps.content: Quit joking. Do you think there's no one else here?

steps.speaker: Yagyu Executive
steps.content: Come out, Thou Voodoos! Carnivore! Stop hiding! You're gonna just sit and watch Syndicate get taken over by others?!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Those are the ones hiding around here. They're all carrying Mania weapons.

steps.speaker: Yagyu Executive
steps.content: Hahaha, idiot! This is our territory, stocked full of our arms everywhere! We won't lose, we can't lose!

steps.speaker: Yagyu Executive
steps.content: Syndicate's order can't be spoiled further. This is our justice! We'll give you neither the inheritance nor Syndicate! It belongs to us!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: It's the Mania. Did they suffer a backlash from their own weapons?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Who knows? I say they've always been insane like this, Mania or not. Let's finish them off, ${PlayerName}.
Perhaps you're triggered by these people who're gradually losing their sanity, or you're suffering the side effects of overusing your potestas out of rage, your senses have become a lot sharper now.
You can clearly feel the nauseating presence clashing increasingly hard in the depths of the earth. Its influence over you has suddenly been amplified.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...Chief, I'll hold them off. Hella, you get Chief out of here and find the Legion.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hecate, are you out of your mind?! What a crappy plan!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Your safety is our priority, that's the order I've received. I can't let you take the risk.
The way this kid's mind works maddens you a bit, especially when she says things like this with a blank face.
You finally understand. It's not because she's cold and ruthless —in the face of orders, Hecate is blunt and stubborn, like a plank of wood.

options: You should listen to my orders
We'll only be worse off without you

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: If you really want me to live, stay beside me and protect me till the end.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...Got it, I'll protect you, untill the end.
